messages:
maria_ops: FYI customer C-9123 reporting p99 spikes (~1.5s) for chat.generate in eu-west for the last ~2h. Traces point to TLS handshake tail and extra cross-zone hops. Anyone seeing similar on infra dashboards?

tom_sre: Which dashboards / probe ids? Any recent edge deploys?

maria_ops: Dashboards -> https://console.redwood/foo/query?span=2h (embed: p99_tls_handshake, ingress-egress-hops). No service deploys during window. Support already filed ticket 4578.

support_bot: Ticket created: C-9123 (https://support.redwood/tickets/4578) — customer reported ~1500ms p99 for token generation.

kiran_infra: Running traceroute from eu-west probe -> target pop. Snippet: 
```
traceroute to api.redwood.prod (35.204.10.2), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  gw-ew1 (10.0.0.1)  0.48 ms  0.42 ms  0.38 ms
 2  core-ew (52.11.8.1)  1.2 ms  1.1 ms  1.1 ms
 3  peer-upstream (198.51.100.1)  1.9 ms  2.0 ms  2.1 ms
 4  us-east-agg (203.0.113.5)  35.1 ms  35.0 ms  34.9 ms  <-- unexpected cross-zone hop
 5  api-edge-ew (35.204.10.2)  35.2 ms  35.0 ms  35.1 ms
```
Hop 4 is handing off to a us-east aggregator then back to eu-edge — matches TLS handshake tails in traces (extra RTT).

eli_infra: I see BGP path change for our /24s at ~10:12UTC: upstream AS X preferred a path via us-east for a subset of prefixes. Likely anycast imbalance + peering flap.

eli_infra: Quick mitigations: 
- adjust egress peer preferences to reduce weight on upstream AS X for eu-west prefixes
- or shift traffic away from the affected eu-west POP to eu-north temporarily
Example: 
```
# shift 30% of traffic off eu-west to eu-north for 20m (canary)
edgectl reroute --from eu-west --to eu-north --percent 30 --duration 20m
```

tom_sre: Alternative lighter change — bump TLS session cache TTL on the affected POP so fewer full handshakes while we stabilize? That might reduce tail. How quickly can we toggle?

kiran_infra: We can flip session cache seconds on the runtime via edge-config; doing `edge-config set --pop eu-west --tls.session_cache_seconds 1800` takes effect within 30s for new workers. Worth doing in parallel.

maria_ops: I'm going to apply the 30% reroute now and increase session cache TTL. Monitoring panels on.

deploy-bot: edgectl: reroute job started id=reroute-abc123 by maria_ops (30% eu-west -> eu-north)

kiran_infra: 5m after reroute: synthetic probes show p99 handshake dropped from ~1.6s -> ~520ms. End-to-end p95 also improved.

support_bot: Customer C-9123 updated: mitigation applied, we're seeing lower latencies; will follow up in 30m.

tom_sre: Good. Next steps: open incident doc (will add BGP timeline), escalate to peering ops to look at upstream AS X instability and request de-flap or preprefs.

maria_ops: Agreed — I'll create a postmortem if this recurs. Also adding a runbook entry: check for cross-zone hops in traceroutes + synthetic tls_handshake metric alerting.

eli_infra: Filing peering ticket now. If traffic still flips back after reroute ends, we'll consider longer reroute and upstream prepref change.

maria_ops: Thanks all :thumbsup: keeping on watch. @support_bot please note mitigation and ping customer to confirm final status.

support_bot: Ticket 4578 updated: mitigation performed, customer notified. Will reopen if latency reoccurs.

maria_ops: Closing thread for now — will re-open if we see new spikes.
